messages.title: Version 3.3.1 Release Notes:
messages.body:
Numerous features and updates have recently been released, including:

1. Leave form preparation — When completing your eTime fortnight, you may be prompted to prepare a leave form if ShiftSync cannot detect an existing request. Sick leave and annual leave are currently supported.

2. Financial Year Review — You can now automatically download payslips containing overtime meal allowances, which may help when preparing your tax return.

3. On-call support — On-call shift, call-out and extension-of-shift handling is being actively developed and improved.

4. 2026 Paramedic Award — New award rates have been added to ShiftSync’s pay calculations.

If you’d like to see a feature added or an issue fixed, please submit it through the Feedback section.
